home.principleServerFirst: Server Components by default; client boundaries must justify themselves.
home.principleTesting: TDD with unit, integration, e2e, accessibility, and visual gates.

marketing.trustLabel: Designed for product, engineering, and platform teams

one.title: Strict by default
one.description: TypeScript and ESLint turn architectural agreements into errors, never warnings.

two.title: Reusable by design
two.description: Accessible primitives and module boundaries prevent repeated UI and tangled behavior.

three.title: AI-ready context
three.description: Canonical rules and task cards give coding agents precise, low-token context.

one.question: Is this suitable for an existing product?
one.answer: Yes. Adopt the contracts incrementally, beginning with boundaries, quality gates, and shared primitives.

two.question: Does strictness slow delivery?
two.answer: The first decisions become explicit; later work accelerates because reviews and agents encounter fewer ambiguities.

three.question: Is a backend included?
three.answer: No false service is advertised. Mock owners and gateway contracts provide clear seams for your real backend.
